correctness.rationale: The count is over N_r starting positions in a prefix of length N_r+1. A carry through c trailing twos changes the ternary digit sum by 1-2c, so a 01 start requires c=0 modulo 3 and initial digit sum 0 modulo 3. Partitioning below the repunit by the highest first-different digit j (necessarily a zero), the bulk case with c<=j-2 leaves an unrestricted digit and gives 2·3^(j-c-2). When c=j-1 the lone stopping digit is 0 or 1 and exactly one choice works iff j=1 modulo 3 and r is not 0 modulo 3; when c=j there is only one candidate, admissible iff j=0 and r=1 modulo 3. The geometric bulk sum and the two boundary counts give the stated three discrepancies. Independently, exact c with c=0 modulo 3 gives density 2/3^(c+2): the stopping digit has two choices and the remaining higher digit sum modulo 3 is uniformly distributed, by the aligned three-letter blocks. Summing over c gives frequency 3/13; truncating the c sum has uniform tail density at most 3^(-K) plus one possible boundary start in a window for c>=K. Bounded factor balance would put every length-N+1 factor count within a fixed bound of N·3/13, by averaging over translates; the repunit deviations contradict this. Each aligned triple contains every letter once, so four prefix errors of magnitude at most 2/3 bound the integer difference of equal-length single-letter counts by 2. The length-two examples 00 at 44 and 11 at 8 show sharpness. A separate direct digit-sum recurrence test matched every cutoff r=1,…,12; the infinite claims follow from the carry count and frequency argument, not these finite checks.
residual_risks: The law is for the contiguous pair 01 and repunit cutoffs only; it does not give maximal discrepancy at arbitrary lengths.

value.rationale: The repunit cutoffs are natural repeated-digit, half-scale prefixes of this substitution word. The exact profile gives negative and positive deviations growing in magnitude on two interleaved logarithmic subsequences and a bounded deviation on the third. It quantifies a concrete separation between bounded single-letter fluctuations and unbounded adjacent-pair fluctuations that neither a limiting frequency nor a qualitative balance criterion resolves.
residual_risks: The result does not identify the global logarithmic constant or a discrepancy law for other factors or bases.
